posts.title: Shrek 2 Remastered - Official Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
posts.summary: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Shrek 2 Remastered, a modern version of the hit co-op adventure game developed by Aspyr. Players will relive iconic moments from iconic locations in the animated film, from the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away to Shrek’s swamp.

posts.summary: The Big Bad Wolf is back. Watch the latest trailer for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, an upcoming narrative-driven adventure game. The new story trailer gives a first look at Bigby's redesigned werewolf form.

posts.title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut - Official Xbox Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
posts.summary: Check out the Xbox Trailer for Zero Parades: Director's Cut, an espionage RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players will endure the trials and tribulations of a single operative on one final mission. The latest update is packed with more material, revisions, improvements, and more.

posts.title: Graytail - Official Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
posts.summary: Graytail is a mystery action-adventure in a 2.5D pixel-art world. A famous pilot has vanished somewhere in the Pacific. A detective with a headache that never stops takes the case, with the pilot's daughter at his side. Grab your cane, get on your motorbike, and uncover the island's secrets.
